patches.anchor: // local mod: the host opts 地灵 into the next match's pool (room.setExtras; default off, personal use only)
old: // local mod: the host opts 地灵 into the next match's pool (room.setExtras; default off, personal use only)
new: // local mod: per-match host options (room.setExtras) — 地灵 (the hidden operator, playtest #17) and devMode (the
// in-match developer switches, playtest #24). The request always carries the full current set with one key patched:
// on the server an absent key means "unchanged", so toggling one option never resets the other. Accepts a boolean
// (treated as 地灵) or an object patch, so the 地灵 button works whether or not this dev-mode mod is applied.

old: ? (on ? t('自用：本局招募池已加入隐藏干员「地灵」（1 阶 · 奇迹 / 远见），点击移除') : t('自用：点击后本局招募池加入隐藏干员「地灵」（1 阶 · 奇迹 / 远见）'))
: t('创建者{state}将隐藏干员「地灵」加入本局招募池（仅创建者可改）', { state: on ? t('已') : t('未') })} placement="top">
${on ? t('✓ 本局加地灵') : t('+ 本局加地灵')}
new: ? (on ? t('自用：本局招募池已加入隐藏干员「地灵」（1 阶 · 奇迹 / 远见），点击移除') : t('自用：点击后本局招募池加入隐藏干员「地灵」（1 阶 · 奇迹 / 远见）'))
: t('创建者{state}将隐藏干员「地灵」加入本局招募池（仅创建者可改）', { state: on ? t('已') : t('未') })} placement="top">
${on ? t('✓ 本局加地灵') : t('+ 本局加地灵')}
// playtest #24 (local dev tool, never upstream): per-match developer-mode switches — during the match's
// 整备期 a DEV panel (ui/devPanel.js) offers shortcuts like 金币 999, so a fix can be verified without
// playing the whole match. Host toggle, default off, everyone sees the state (the 地灵 option's shape).
? (on ? t('自用：本局已开启开发者模式（整备期左侧 DEV 面板，如金币 999），点击关闭') : t('自用：开启后本局整备期出现开发者快捷开关（如金币 999），便于快速验证改动效果'))
: t('创建者{state}本局的开发者模式（对局内测试快捷开关，仅创建者可改）', { state: on ? t('已开启') : t('未开启') })} placement="top">
${on ? t('✓ 本局开发者模式') : t('+ 本局开发者模式')}
